title: Homemade chilli paste products linked to cluster of rat poisoning cases in south-east Queensland
summary: Queensland Health has issued an alert for people to be aware of the products they warn could still be circulating in the Logan community Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Health authorities have identified homemade chilli paste products as the source of a cluster of rat poisoning cases in south-east Queensland. Five people from the same geographic area presented to hospitals earlier in October with symptoms consistent with being exposed to brodifacoum, the active ingredient in rat poison.
